work: Royal Caribbean currently lists Up, Up & Away as a separately booked helium balloon ride at Perfect Day at CocoCay, outside the island waterpark admission. The 2019 manufacturer reference identifies a tethered balloon. Official editor searches for Up, Up and Away, CocoCay and helium balloon found no matching standalone; Park searches for CocoCay, Perfect Day and Royal Caribbean found no Bahamas park. A 2024 Commons photograph clearly shows the balloon and its booth. It was visually checked, imported with CC BY 4.0 credit and published before the attraction. Eight locale pages and the public image binary returned HTTP 200 before the Facebook post was published.
qualification: Fixed tethered balloon, separately booked on a broader cruise island destination; the nearby waterpark is a separate area and no artificial parent Park is created.
